subject: Agricultural Science
q: The best soil for most crops is…
explain: Loamy soil holds enough water, drains well and is rich in humus.

subject: Agricultural Science
q: Which practice adds nitrogen to the soil?
explain: Legumes such as cowpea and groundnut add nitrogen to the soil.

subject: Agricultural Science
q: Growing maize and cassava together on the same land at the same time is…
explain: Mixed cropping grows two or more crops together at the same time.
